text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"WPM-003","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N1","page":1,"quote":"T + S NOTE : H.T.PROCESS : XXXXX HARDNESS & DEPTH : XXXXX FINISH & DEPTH : XXXXX TEST COUPON SIZE : XXXXX (20mmLENGTH - 01NOS) WELD CLASS : B IF APPLICABLE"}],"comment":"Note N1 leaves the heat-treatment process as 'XXXXX' without showing the area to be case hardened on the drawing, even though note N3 calls out case hardening. The shop cannot know which surfaces require the hardened case, risking incorrect treatment or scrapping the part. Replace the 'XXXXX' placeholders with the actual process and cross-hatch or otherwise indicate the areas to be hardened on the view.","recommended_correction":"Fill in the heat-treatment process in N1 and add a hatched or marked indication on the drawing views showing exactly which surfaces are to be case hardened per N3."},{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"---"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT NOTE :- 1) TO BE CASE HARDENED UPTO 56~60 HRC. 2) CASE DEPTH 0.8~1.2mm. 3) THREADS TO BE KEEP SOFT. 4) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The title-block heat_treatment field is '---', contradicting note N3 which specifies case hardening to 56–60 HRC with a 0.8–1.2 mm case depth. This inconsistency can cause the heat-treatment step to be missed during manufacturing planning because the title block is the primary process-routing reference. Update the title-block heat_treatment field to state 'CASE HARDENED' (or equivalent) so it agrees with note N3.","recommended_correction":"Change the title-block heat_treatment field from '---' to reflect the case-hardening requirement specified in note N3."}]}
